subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Battery Management Systems
description: A micro-lesson that makes Battery Management Systems usable.

hook.text: A battery pack has thousands of cells, and every single one must be monitored individually.

buildup.text: The BMS tracks voltage, temperature, and state of charge for each cell in real time.

discovery.text: It balances cells so weaker ones don't drag down the pack—keeping all cells at the same charge level.

twist.text: If any cell drifts outside safe limits, the BMS can shut it down to prevent thermal runaway.

climax.text: The quality of the BMS software often matters more than the chemistry for real-world battery performance.

punchline.text: Thousands of cells need a digital babysitter watching every one.

quiz.question: What does a Battery Management System (BMS) monitor?
options: Voltage, temperature, and charge of each cell
